title: UK's most haunted pubs ranked and the results will give you chills
excerpt: Over 100 pubs with reported paranormal activity across the UK have been analysed in a new Haunted Pub Index and the winner has not one but three spirits
content:
UK's most haunted pubs ranked – is your local on the list

Over 100 pubs with reported paranormal activity across the UK have been analysed in a new Haunted Pub Index and the winner has not one but three spirits

Andrew Gilpin Deputy Editor in Chief

10:31, 28 Oct 2026

Scotland has been crowned home to the UK's most haunted boozers in a chilling new study. More than 100 pubs with reported paranormal activity across the UK have been examined in a new Haunted Pub Index.

‌

The research, from VELO, identified the UK's most haunted pub as The Drovers Inn in Inverarnan, Scotland, boasting nearly 300 Google Reviews that reference its eerie nature. Among the spirits said to haunt the inn are a young girl and a cattle herder called Angus.

Claiming second spot is The Golden Fleece in York, with over 230 Google Reviews mentioning its spine-tingling reputation. The historic watering hole is believed to be inhabited by more than 15 ghosts, with reports ranging from unexplained footsteps to mysterious apparitions. Such is its notoriety for paranormal activity that the pub even runs its own ghost hunts.

Completing the top three is The Ancient Ram Inn in Gloucestershire, which has garnered more than 130 Google Reviews citing its haunted atmosphere. The 12th-century establishment is reportedly home to around 20 ghosts, with punters claiming to have witnessed shadowy figures, unexplained noises and other mysterious occurrences.

To discover where Brits are most likely to come face-to-face with a spirit, VELO examined reported ghosts, paranormal sightings and Google Review mentions to rank the nation's most notorious haunted drinking establishments. The study revealed that Scotland boasts the most haunted pubs, with its centuries-old castles, historic structures, and dark folklore solidifying its eerie reputation.

Edinburgh particularly stands out for its ghost stories, with underground vaults, ancient graveyards and historic streets all contributing to the city's supernatural heritage.

Yorkshire featured nine pubs in the VELO research, while London dominated the list with 27, including The Golden Fleece, The Grenadier, The Ten Bells and The Spaniards Inn.

With boozers nationwide connected to everything from soldiers and smugglers to mysterious figures, Brits might want to reconsider heading to the bar solo this spooky season.

A spokesperson for VELO said: "We've uncovered some of the UK's spookiest pubs, giving Brits plenty of unusual places to explore this spooky season. Life is full of moments we don't want to miss – and an evening in a spooky watering hole as we approach Halloween is certainly one of them."

The top 10 haunted pubs in the UK

1. The Drovers Inn – Inverarnan, Scotland: Three reported spirits, including a young girl and a cattle drover known as Angus, are associated with this remote Loch Lomond inn.

2. The Golden Fleece – York: Around 15 reported spirits are associated with this historic pub, adding to York's already famous reputation for ghostly goings-on.

3. The Ancient Ram Inn – Wotton-under-Edge, Gloucestershire: Around 20 spirits have reportedly been associated with the building, giving it one of the highest reported ghost counts in the research.

4. The Skirrid Mountain Inn – Wales: Five commonly reported spirits are associated with this historic Welsh pub, tucked beneath Skirrid Mountain.

5. The Mermaid Inn – Rye: Tales of smugglers, ghostly apparitions and mysterious occurrences have earned this ancient boozer a distinctly haunting reputation.

6. The Banshee Labyrinth – Edinburgh: At least four spirits are reportedly associated with this underground Edinburgh venue, where the setting is almost as eerie as the stories.

7. The White Horse Inn – Pluckley, Kent: Four reported ghosts are associated with the pub, which sits in a village already famed for its supernatural folklore.

8. The Grenadier – London: The Mayfair establishment is reportedly haunted by one main spirit, Cedric, beaten to death after cheating during a game of cards.

9. The Bate Hall – Macclesfield: Reports put the number of spirits associated with the pub anywhere between 14 and 21, making it one of the most ghost-heavy venues in the research.

10. The Red Lion – Avebury: At least five spirits are reportedly associated with the historic pub, including a figure known as Florrie.
